# Local third-party runtime assets

`xmldsigjs` is deliberately served from this directory at runtime. No CDN is
used by the deployed application.

The generated browser bundle is not hand-edited. Run:

```bash
npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npm run vendor:xmldsig
npm run verify:vendor
```

`vendor:xmldsig` bundles the pinned `xmldsigjs@2.8.8` package and its browser
runtime dependencies into `xmldsigjs-2.8.8.bundle.js`, computes SHA-384, writes
`vendor-manifest.json`, and updates the Subresource Integrity value in
`public/index.html`.

`verify:vendor` independently recalculates the checked-in/generated bytes and
requires the HTML SRI value, manifest SRI value, and hexadecimal SHA-384 value
to agree.

The upstream MIT licence is retained as
`xmldsigjs-2.8.8.LICENSE.txt`.
